svg.title: Aho-Corasick Automaton: Trie Goto, BFS Failure Links, and Output Links
svg.desc: Animated Aho-Corasick multi-pattern automaton for dictionary {he, she, his, hers} scanning text T = "ushers" in a single O(n + z) pass, showing solid goto edges, dashed BFS failure fallback from node 9 (she) to node 2 (he), and dictionary output links firing simultaneous matches.
svg.text: Aho-Corasick Multi-Pattern Automaton · Goto, Failure & Output Links
Dictionary {"he", "she", "his", "hers"} compiled via BFS into an O(|T| + sum|P_i| + matches) streaming finite state machine
1. Automaton Topology (Solid: Trie Goto · Dashed Amber: fail(u) · Dotted Violet: Output Link)

g.text: Insert every pattern P_i in O(sum |P_i|).
Mark terminal nodes with pattern IDs.
Root missing edges self-loop to root 0.
Level-order BFS links each node to its
longest proper suffix present in the Trie.
dict(u) jumps straight to nearest accepting
suffix on fail chain in O(1) per match.
Total scan: O(|T| + sum|P_i| + z hits)
